parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description:
The database ID. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to obtain this ID.

The API operation uses the schema from this database to generate the SQL statement.

parameters.name: Dialect
parameters.description: The SQL dialect. If unspecified, the system defaults to `MySQL` and generates a standard SQL statement.

parameters.name: Knowledge
parameters.description: Supplementary business information to help the model better understand the question.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The processing level. The default value is `base`.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The Qwen series model to use.

parameters.name: Question
parameters.description: The natural language question to convert into an SQL statement.

parameters.name: RealLoginUserUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user who calls the operation.

parameters.name: TableNames
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of table names. If specified, the model uses only these tables to generate the SQL statement.
